title: The Hidden Look-Ahead: Point-in-Time Leakage in Electricity Market Data
note: arXiv record: v1 only, submitted 2026-10-18, single author (A. Alfalah), cs.LG with cs.CE and stat.AP, CC BY 4.0, 13 pages. No code, data or repository link on the record.

title: The Hidden Look-Ahead: Point-in-Time Leakage in Electricity Market Data
note: Abstract: 128,656 forecast runs from ten weather-model configurations matched to the GB day-ahead and first intraday auction gates, 2022-2026. Picking the latest run issued before the gate picks a run unpublished at the gate on over 99% of delivery days for six of ten configurations at one gate; GFS day-ahead 0.6% in winter, 99.8% in summer; apparent accuracy gain -9% to +24%.

title: The Hidden Look-Ahead: Point-in-Time Leakage in Electricity Market Data
note: Full text, data: one commercial archive (Energy Quantified) with issue, publication and finalisation times per run; vendor forecasts of GB wind, solar and demand driven by GFS, ICON, ECMWF and AIFS variants (AIFS 2026 only); 1,734 delivery days, 1 Jan 2022 to 30 Sep 2026. Gates in UK clock time: day-ahead 09:50, first intraday 17:30, converted to UTC per day.

title: The Hidden Look-Ahead: Point-in-Time Leakage in Electricity Market Data
note: Full text, leakage table: shares are split by summer/winter clock, no all-days column, and the body never derives the abstract's count of six. Weighting the seasons by their days gives six above 99% at one gate (ICON-SR, ECMWF-SR, ECMWF-SR-ENS, ECMWF-ENS, AIFS, AIFS-ENS); that is a reader's inference. Median publication delay after issue: 2.75 h (ICON-SR) to 6.72 h (ECMWF-ENS).

title: The Hidden Look-Ahead: Point-in-Time Leakage in Electricity Market Data
note: Full text, accuracy section: gain = relative MAE difference of naive vs finalisation-rule selection against vendor outturns (themselves revised), 882 delivery days 2024-01-01 to 2026-05-31, three deterministic configurations, 95% block-bootstrap intervals. Demand, all days: GFS day-ahead 17.9 [16.2, 19.7], GFS intraday -4.6 [-5.8, -3.4], ICON day-ahead 13.5, ECMWF-SR day-ahead 13.0.

title: The Hidden Look-Ahead: Point-in-Time Leakage in Electricity Market Data
note: Full text, extremes and margins: -9% is GFS demand at the intraday gate in summer (-8.6), +24% is ICON demand at the day-ahead gate in summer (24.2; GFS 24.0). A margin of 5 minutes moves the ICON summer day-ahead selection from a 2.8 h old run to an 8.8 h old one; two-cycle configurations lose 12 h. Publication delays drifted (ECMWF fell 0.6-1.4 h after mid-2024).

title: The Hidden Look-Ahead: Point-in-Time Leakage in Electricity Market Data
note: Full text, scope: no price or load model is fitted; the downstream effect on predictive performance is left unmeasured. Eight-step timestamp audit protocol. No pre-registration, no code or data statement. Stated limits: one vendor, one market, timestamp meaning rests on delay regularity and a one-evening live check of three runs, as-of-gate values not recovered.
